14154-the-tale-of-terror-a-study-of-the-.title: A Study of the Gothic Romance
14154-the-tale-of-terror-a-study-of-the-.creator: Edith Birkhead M.A.
14154-the-tale-of-terror-a-study-of-the-.description: A book by Edith Birkhead M.A.. ; _The Romance of the Forest_, and her use of suspense; heroines: _The Mysteries of Udolpho_; illustrations of Mrs. Radcliffe's methods; _The Italian_; villains; her historical accuracy and "unexplained" spectre in _Gaston de Blondeville_; her reading; style; descriptions of scenery; position in the history of the novel.

arxiv-2009-06209.title: An Open-Source Integration of Process Mining Features into the Camunda Workflow Engine: Data Extraction and Challenges
arxiv-2009-06209.creator: Alessandro Berti 1 , Wil van der Aalst 1 , David Zang 2 , Magdalena Lang 2
arxiv-2009-06209.description: Abstract Process mining provides techniques to improve the performance and compliance of operational processes. Although sometimes the term “workflow mining” is used, the application in the context of Workflow Management (WFM) and Business Process Management (BPM) systems is limited. The main reason is that WFM/BPM systems control the process, leaving less room for flexibility and the corresponding deviations.

arxiv-2012-05684.title: Recurrent Point Review Models
arxiv-2012-05684.creator: Kostadin Cvejoski 1 3 , Ramsés J. Sánchez 1 2 , Bogdan Georgiev 3 , Christian Bauckhage 3 and César Ojeda 4
arxiv-2012-05684.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Kostadin Cvejoski 1 3 , Ramsés J. Sánchez 1 2 , Bogdan Georgiev 3 , Christian Bauckhage 3 and César Ojeda 4. Deep neural network models represent the state-of-the-art methodologies for natural language processing. Here we build on top of these methodologies to incorporate temporal information and model how review data changes with time.

arxiv-2203-16877.title: Asymptotic behavior of the Dirichlet energy on Poisson point clouds Thanks: Preprint SISSA 06/2022/MATE
arxiv-2203-16877.creator: Andrea Braides, Marco Caroccia
arxiv-2203-16877.description: Abstract . We prove that quadratic pair interactions for functions defined on planar Poisson clouds and taking into account pairs of sites of distance up to a certain (large-enough) threshold can be almost surely approximated by the multiple of the Dirichlet energy by a deterministic constant.

arxiv-2211-08307.title: A New Simheuristic Approach for Stochastic Runway Scheduling
arxiv-2211-08307.creator: Rob Shone Centre for Transport and Logistics (CENTRAL), Lancaster University, Bailrigg, Lancaster, UK. LA1 4YW. Email: r.shone@lancaster.ac.uk Kevin Glazebrook Centre for Transport and Logistics (CENTRAL), Lancaster University, Bailrigg, Lancaster, UK. LA1 4YW. Email: k.glazebrook@lancaster.ac.uk Ko
arxiv-2211-08307.description: Abstract Abstract We consider a stochastic, dynamic runway scheduling problem involving aircraft landings on a single runway. Sequencing decisions are made with knowledge of the estimated arrival times (ETAs) of all aircraft due to arrive at the airport, and these ETAs vary according to continuous-time stochastic processes.

arxiv-2303-15914.title: Characterization of harmonic modes and parasitic resonances in multi-mode superconducting coplanar resonators
arxiv-2303-15914.creator: Cenk Beydeda, Konstantin Nikolaou, Marius Tochtermann, Nikolaj G. Ebensperger, Gabriele Untereiner, Ahmed Farag, Philipp Karl, Monika Ubl, Harald Giessen, Martin Dressel, Marc Scheffler
arxiv-2303-15914.description: Abstract Planar superconducting microwave transmission line resonators can be operated at multiple harmonic resonance frequencies. This allows covering wide spectral regimes with high sensitivity, as it is desired e.g. for cryogenic microwave spectroscopy. A common complication of such experiments is the presence of undesired ‘spurious’ additional resonances, which are due to standing waves within the resonator substrate or housing box.

arxiv-2402-01553.title: Q Q -factor: A measure of competition between the topper and the average in percolation and in SOC
arxiv-2402-01553.creator: Asim Ghosh 1 , S. S. Manna 2, and Bikas K. Chakrabarti 3,4
arxiv-2402-01553.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Asim Ghosh 1 , S. S. Manna 2, and Bikas K. Chakrabarti 3,4. We define the Q Q -factor in the percolation problem as the quotient of the size of the largest cluster and the average size of all clusters.

arxiv-2412-07480.title: Optimizing pulsed blowing parameters for active separation control in a one-sided diffuser using reinforcement learning
arxiv-2412-07480.creator: Alexandra Müller 1, Tobias Schesny 2, Ben Steinfurth 3, Julien Weiss 4
arxiv-2412-07480.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning is employed to optimize the periodic forcing signal of a pulsed blowing system that controls flow separation in a fully-turbulent R ​ e θ = 1000 Re_{\theta}=1000 diffuser flow. Based on the state of the wind tunnel experiment that is determined with wall shear-stress measurements, Proximal Policy Optimization is used to iteratively adjust the forcing signal.

arxiv-2505-18746.title: C 3 C^{3} -Bench: The Things Real Disturbing LLM based Agent in Multi-Tasking
arxiv-2505-18746.creator: Peijie Yu, Yifan Yang, Jinjian Li, Zelong Zhang, Haorui Wang, Xiao Feng, Feng Zhang
arxiv-2505-18746.description: Abstract Agents based on large language models leverage tools to modify environments, revolutionizing how AI interacts with the physical world. Unlike traditional NLP tasks that rely solely on historical dialogue for responses, these agents must consider more complex factors, such as inter-tool relationships, environmental feedback and previous decisions, when making choices. Current research typically evaluates agents via multi-turn dialogues.

arxiv-2506-13937.title: Beyond the Plane: A 3D Representation of Human Personal Space for Socially-Aware Robotics
arxiv-2506-13937.creator: Caio C. G. Ribeiro, Douglas G. Macharet
arxiv-2506-13937.description: Abstract The increasing presence of robots in human environments requires them to exhibit socially appropriate behavior, adhering to social norms. A critical aspect in this context is the concept of personal space, a psychological boundary around an individual that influences their comfort based on proximity.

arxiv-2508-01561.title: One Subgoal at a Time: Zero-Shot Generalization to Arbitrary Linear Temporal Logic Requirements in Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2508-01561.creator: Zijian Guo, İlker Işık, H. M. Sabbir Ahmad, Wenchao Li
arxiv-2508-01561.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zijian Guo, İlker Işık, H. M. Sabbir Ahmad, Wenchao Li. Generalizing to complex and temporally extended task objectives and safety constraints remains a critical challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Linear temporal logic (LTL) offers a unified formalism to specify such requirements, yet existing methods are limited in their abilities to handle nested long-horizon tasks and safety constraints, and cannot identify situations when a subgoal is not satisfiable and an alternative should be sought.

arxiv-2508-09176.title: DQT: Dynamic Quantization Training via Dequantization-Free Nested Integer Arithmetic
arxiv-2508-09176.creator: Hazem Hesham Yousef Shalby, Fabrizio Pittorino, Francesca Palermo, Diana Trojaniello, Manuel Roveri
arxiv-2508-09176.description: Abstract The deployment of deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices relies on quantization. While static, uniform quantization applies a fixed bit-width to all inputs, it fails to adapt to their varying complexity. Dynamic, instance-based mixed-precision quantization promises a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off by allocating higher precision only when needed.

arxiv-2509-00853.title: Berele row-insertion and quantum symmetric pairs
arxiv-2509-00853.creator: Hideya Watanabe
arxiv-2509-00853.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hideya Watanabe. The Berele row-insertion is a symplectic analogue of the Schensted row-insertion. In the present paper, we provide it with a representation theoretical interpretation via the quantum symmetric pairs of type A ​ II A\mathrm{II} . As applications, we lift Berele’s Robinson–Schensted correspondence and Kobayashi–Matsumura’s Robinson–Schensted–Knuth (RSK for short) correspondence to isomorphisms of representations over a quantum symmetric pair coideal subalgebra, and establish the dual RSK correspondence of type A ​ II A\mathrm{II} .

arxiv-2510-06505.title: A Median Perspective on Unlabeled Data for Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2510-06505.creator: Momin Abbas, Ali Falahati, Hossein Goli, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri
arxiv-2510-06505.description: Abstract Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection plays a crucial role in ensuring the robustness and reliability of machine learning systems deployed in real-world applications. Recent approaches have explored the use of unlabeled data, showing potential for enhancing OOD detection capabilities. However, effectively utilizing unlabeled in-the-wild data remains challenging due to the mixed nature of both in-distribution (InD) and OOD samples.

arxiv-2511-11610.title: ARise: an Augmented Reality Mobile Application to Improve Cultural Heritage Resilience
arxiv-2511-11610.creator: Angelica Urbanelli 1 , Marina Nadalin 1 , Mario Chiesa 1 , Rojin Bayat 1 , Massimo Migliorini 1 , Claudio Rossi 1 1 LINKS Foundation, Torino (TO), Italy
arxiv-2511-11610.description: Abstract The preservation of cultural heritage faces increasing threats from climate change effects and environmental hazards, demanding innovative solutions that can promote awareness and resilience. This paper presents ARise, an Augmented Reality mobile application designed to enhance public engagement with cultural sites while raising awareness about the local impacts of climate change.

britannica-1911-moravia.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-moravia.description: Article 'Moravia' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Owing to the configuration of the soil, the climate of Moravia varies more than might be expected in so small an area, so that, while the vine and maize are cultivated successfully in the southern plains, the weather in the mountainous districts is somewhat rigorous. The mean annual temperature at Brünn is 48° F.

pmc-10581390.title: Jiawei Danxuan Koukang Alleviates Arecoline Induced Oral Mucosal Lesions: Network Pharmacology and the Combined Ultra-High Performance Liquid Chromatography (UPLC) and Mass Spectrometry (MS)
pmc-10581390.creator: Linghang Zhou, Jin Tan, Yuzhe Dai, Keke Zhu, Yanbo Xiao, Dan Wu, Zongkang Wang, Yisi Tan, Yijie Qin
pmc-10581390.description: PurposeArecoline is one of the main toxic components of arecoline to cause oral mucosal lesions or canceration, which seriously affects the survival and life quality of patients. This study analyzed the mechanism of Jiawei Danxuan Koukang (JDK) in alleviating arecoline induced oral mucosal lesions, to provide new insights for the treatment of oral submucosal fibrosis (OSF) or cancerosis.

pmc-11357844.title: LSWH100: A handshape dataset for Brazilian sign language (Libras) using SignWriting
pmc-11357844.creator: Vicente Coelho Lobo-Neto, Helio Pedrini
pmc-11357844.description: This paper presents Libras SignWriting Handshape (LSWH100), a new handshape dataset focused on Sign Language Recognition. The dataset includes 144,000 synthetic images of a realistic human hand, covering 100 distinct handshape classes used in Brazilian Sign Language (Libras). Handshapes are named using the convention from SignWriting, a writing system for sign languages.

pmc-11378887.title: Protocol for the derivation of primary cancer stem cell lines from human ependymal tumors
pmc-11378887.creator: Cory M. Richman, Peter B. Dirks, Michael D. Taylor, Kulandaimanuvel Antony Michealraj
pmc-11378887.description: SummaryCancer stem cells (CSCs) established from surgical biopsies closely mimic the human context and can be used to investigate disease mechanisms, genetic fitness, and therapeutic evaluation. Here, we present a protocol for the derivation of primary patient-derived CSC lines from ependymal tumors. We describe the necessary steps, from surgical intervention and biopsy to the dissociation of ependymomas to derive cultures.

pmc-11520224.title: Preventing Cardiac Damage in Patients Treated for Breast Cancer and Lymphoma
pmc-11520224.creator: David Austin, Rebecca H Maier, Nasima Akhter, Mohammad Sayari, Emmanuel Ogundimu, Jamie M Maddox, Sharareh Vahabi, Alison C Humphreys, Janine Graham, Helen Oxenham, Sophie Haney, Nicola Cresti, Mark Verrill, Wendy Osborne, Kathryn L Wright, Rebecca Goranova, James R Bailey, Nagesh Kalakonda, Mac Mac
pmc-11520224.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCardiotoxicity is a concern for cancer survivors undergoing anthracycline chemotherapy. Enalapril has been explored for its potential to mitigate cardiotoxicity in cancer patients. The dose-dependent cardiotoxicity effects of anthracyclines can be detected early through the biomarker cardiac troponin.ObjectivesThe PROACT (Preventing Cardiac Damage in Patients Treated for Breast Cancer and Lymphoma) clinical trial assessed the effectiveness of enalapril in preventing cardiotoxicity, manifesting as myocardial injury and cardiac function impairment, in patients undergoing high-dose anthracycline-based chemotherapy for breast cancer or non-Hodgkin lymphoma.MethodsThis prospective, multicenter,

pmc-12564469.title: Stability Matters: Revealing Causal Roles of G-Quadruplexes (G4s) in Regulation of Chromatin and Transcription
pmc-12564469.creator: Ke Xiao, Rongxin Zhang, Tiantong Tao, Huiling Shu, Hao Huang, Xiao Sun, Jing Tu, Peter Pelka
pmc-12564469.description: Background: G-quadruplexes (G4s) are non-canonical higher-order nucleic acid structures that form at guanine-rich motifs, with features spanning both secondary and tertiary structural levels. These dynamic structures play pivotal roles in diverse cellular processes. Endogenous G4s (eG4s) function through their dynamically formed structures, prompting the hypothesis that their thermostability, as a key structural property, may critically influence their functionality.

pmc-12679004.title: Preventive of deep vein thrombosis in cancer patients after peripherally inserted central catheter catheterization using a diversified comprehensive teaching model
pmc-12679004.creator: Xiao-Ying Zhao, Yan-Yu Lu, Xian Hong, Xiao-Yan Wu, Mei-Fang Ruan
pmc-12679004.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Peripherally inserted central catheter (PICC) is the preferred intravenous route for chemotherapy in patients with cancer, but its complications, especially deep vein thrombosis (DVT), are becoming increasingly prevalent. Medical staff proficient in intubation and maintenance techniques can reduce complications.

pmc-12688589.title: Bronchiectasis complicated by pulmonary aspergillosis: a multicenter study on prognosis and risk factors
pmc-12688589.creator: Jie Yang, Xinyu Wang, Shuai Lu, Kui Zhang, Xin Su
pmc-12688589.description: BackgroundAspergillus-related pulmonary diseases are frequent in bronchiectasis patients due to the impaired mucociliary clearance. However, research on the characteristics and factors of aspergillosis in patients with bronchiectasis is limited. The study aims to assess the prevalence and characteristics of pulmonary aspergillosis (PA) in patients with bronchiectasis, and identify potential factors linked to aspergillosis complications.

pmc-12993302.title: Analysis of clinical features of AECOPD at different altitudes and GOLD stages in high-altitude regions
pmc-12993302.creator: Hongen Zhou, Macuo Bian, Xiaoxuan Huang, Yangzong Deji
pmc-12993302.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo analyse the clinical features of AECOPD (acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) at different altitudes and GOLD (global initiative of chronic obstructive lung disease) stages in high-altitude regions.MethodThis was a retrospective cross-sectional study. Patients diagnosed with AECOPD through pulmonary function tests and hospitalised in People’s Hospital of the Tibet Autonomous Region from September 2018 to March 2024 were included.

pmc-13071740.title: Lightweight hybrid foundation model for lung cancer prognosis based on low-dose chest X-ray images
pmc-13071740.creator: Helen Haile Hayeso, Zenebe Markos Lonseko, Fahad Mushabbab G Alotaibi, Tao Gan, Peifeng Shi, Shuqi Dong, Nini Rao
pmc-13071740.description: BackgroundLung cancer (LC) is the leading cause of cancer mortality worldwide. Accurate prognosis in vulnerable populations, particularly in low-resource settings remains challenging with high radiation dose of standard imaging modalities. While chest X-rays (CXRs) are safer and more accessible, their low spatial resolution limits prognostic accuracy.
